transport: headless stream-json; ACP not required for initial pilot
proposed_argv: Synthetic inline fixture only: def add(a,b): return a-b. Correct sum of 2 and 3 is 5. Return JSON probe=synthetic-review-1, sum_value=5 and explain the wrong operator. Do not call tools.

scope.source: Only synthetic inline arithmetic example and synthetic fixture directory
scope.host_paths: System runtime/lib files readonly + exact agy binary + synthetic directory readonly. /tmp and HOME ephemeral. No actual home or client code.
scope.network: Unshared namespace; no external connectivity allowed in this command
scope.auth: No keyring, DBus, cookies, credentials or token env passed. Authentication cannot be claimed with this command.
scope.tools: Native deny settings for all documented action namespaces, no MCP configured, no browser profile/display/DBus mounted. Native subagent/hook denial has no verified universal toggle in this installation; remains blocker.

budgets.first_response_policy: Observe as metric only; hard outer deadline60s. No undocumented timeout extension.

cancellation.required: GNU timeout hard60s around bwrap, new session and PID namespace teardown; controller must wait/reap and check observed descendant PIDs absent before any new operation.

interrupt_on: undeclared tool, MCP, browser or subagent activity
unsafe path or any external/network access attempt
expected_receipts: input SHA + binary SHA + effective settings/argv
native init/result events and contract validation
auth completion evidence without token or account contents
controller-observed denials and unchanged fixture/host marker hashes, not claims in model JSON
blocking_conditions: No approved inference network/auth mechanism in isolated runtime
No verified way to disable/observe all native subagents, hooks, plugins before provider start
Native permission denials not proven using provider; OS-only proof is not sufficient

No owner authorization for provider execution; offline command cannot prove authenticated inference. Successful synthetic OS probes do not close native tool enforcement or credential/egress conditions.
next_owner_authorization: Separate approval needed for exact inference-only egress and an officially supported narrowly scoped authentication mechanism. Do not request tokens in chat, mount full keyring/home or silently use a different billing/API-key route. Until specified, no provider execution.
